content: Definition of Valid Feature Selection Let S be a FMFeature- SelectionSet and F be the feature set of S . S is a valid feature selection if all the following constraints are obeyed: • [TPS_FMDT_00046] (Semantics of FMFeatureDecomposition ) • [TPS_FMDT_00045] (Semantics of FMFeatureRestriction ) • [TPS_FMDT_00044] (Semantics of FMFeatureRelation )
